data.title: The Alba Furnished Residences
data.about:
Introducing the exquisite The Alba Furnished Residences, a glamorous addition to the iconic Palm Jumeirah in Dubai, developed by the esteemed OMNIYAT. This project includes luxury serviced apartments and an elegant hotel designed by the renowned Zaha Hadid Architects with the prestigious management of the Dorchester Collection. 

The Alba Furnished Residences offers a selection of residences, featuring a diverse mix of 2 to 3-bedroom options with generous floor plans ranging from 1,800 to 2,850 sq. ft. This remarkable mixed-use development encapsulates modern elegance, ensuring that each living space caters to the refined tastes of its discerning clientele, while also providing flexible living arrangements for various lifestyles.

Residents can indulge in a wealth of luxurious amenities, including expansive terraces that invite the tranquility of the outdoors, along with access to a state-of-the-art wellness facility designed for relaxation and rejuvenation.

characteristics_module.title: Exceptional Luxury Redefined: The Alba Furnished Residences
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exclusive partnership with Dorchester Collection, ensuring unparalleled service and luxury management.
  • Stunning views of the iconic Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah, seamlessly blending nature and architecture.
  • First-ever garden retreat by the sea, offering residents a unique outdoor living experience.
  • Interior design excellence by award-winning studio YODEZEEN, emphasizing modern elegance.
  • State-of-the-art wellness facility designed for the ultimate relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Generous terraces for residents to enjoy breathtaking views and outdoor leisure.

image.name: The Alba Furnished Residences at Palm Jumeirah

location_tile.title: Embrace the Apex of Luxury Living on Palm Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Situated on the stunning Palm Jumeirah, Alba Furnished Residences offers residents a unique blend of prime location and luxurious lifestyle. Surrounded by pristine beaches and breathtaking sea views, this prestigious address provides easy access to a plethora of upscale dining, shopping, and entertainment options. The locality boasts an inviting atmosphere, where residents can enjoy sun-soaked days on the beach or leisurely strolls along the waterfront promenades.

Moreover, the strategic placement of Alba ensures seamless connectivity to the rest of Dubai. It stands as a gateway to the city’s most iconic landmarks, allowing residents to embrace the vibrant urban lifestyle while retreating to their tranquil sanctuary. The exclusive community of Palm Jumeirah is celebrated for its prestigious lifestyle, offering unmatched privacy and serenity amidst the bustling city.

  • 10 Minutes to Burj Al Arab
  • 15 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates
  • 20 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 25 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 30 Minutes to Dubai International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Discover exquisite living at The Alba, featuring 2 and 3-bed residences and a hotel. The beachfront project is located in the iconic community of Palm Jumeirah.

more_info.answer: Alba Furnished Residences offers a range of options including fully furnished residences with 2 to 3 bedroom layouts, as well as unfurnished residences for flexible living arrangements.
more_info.question: What types of apartments are available at Alba Furnished Residences?

more_info.answer: This project features state-of-the-art wellness facilities, generous terraces, an exclusive garden retreat by the sea, fully furnished residences, and 24-hour concierge services.
more_info.question: What amenities are provided at Alba Furnished Residences?

more_info.answer: The project includes a variety of units designed to cater to luxury living, featuring both furnished and unfurnished options, ensuring a perfect fit for diverse preferences.
more_info.question: How many units are there in Alba Furnished Residences?

more_info.answer: The expected handover date for Alba Furnished Residences is slated for 2028.
